questions.q: What does it mean for a reference data object to be 'partitioned'?
options: It is designed to be split across multiple reference data sets, with a determinant assigned to exactly one set per object type
It can never be edited after creation
It is only visible to administrators
It is physically stored on a separate database server
questions.explain: Partitioned reference data can be split into multiple sets (like separate payment terms lists), with each determinant value assigned to one set.

questions.q: What happens with a reference data object that is NOT partitioned?
options: Every business unit creates its own private copy automatically
There is only ever the Common Set, and every business unit sees identical values
The object cannot be used by any business unit
It requires a secondary ledger to function
questions.explain: Non-partitioned reference data only exists in the Common Set; there is no business-unit-specific variation to configure.

questions.q: Besides business unit, what are other examples of determinant types this lesson mentions?
options: There are no other determinant types; business unit is the only one
Only currency and country
Ledger and project unit, depending on the reference data object
Legal reporting unit only
questions.explain: Depending on the object, the determinant type can be the ledger or the project unit, not only business unit.

questions.q: Is the determinant type for a given reference data object something a consultant chooses during configuration?
options: Only for objects related to legal entities
Determinant type only applies to the chart of accounts
Yes, any determinant type can be chosen for any object
No — the determinant type is fixed per object; what you configure is which determinant value a given set is assigned to
questions.explain: The determinant type is fixed based on the object type itself; the consultant configures which specific business unit, ledger, or other value maps to which set.

questions.q: What does it mean for a business unit to 'subscribe' to a reference data set?
options: It pays an additional licensing fee
It accesses a shared, non-exclusive set rather than owning its own distinct copy
It creates a brand-new partitioned set automatically
It is a synonym for assigning a legal entity's registered address
questions.explain: Subscription describes a business unit's access to a shared reference data set, behaving like the Common Set pattern rather than exclusive ownership.
